MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_SERPENT_SLAYERS.des:
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, {EliteBonus} more to elites and bosses.
Then remove one of your debuffs completely.
Combined level {UnionLevel} (+1 damage per level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_DWARVEN_CRAFT.title: Dwarven Craft
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_DWARVEN_CRAFT.descr:
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits} times.
Also carries [gold]Gram[/gold]'s effect: +{GramBonus} damage per hit (Gram's level).
Combined level {UnionLevel} (+1 damage per hit every 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_BEFORE_THE_SHEATH.d:
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. It ignores [gold]Block[/gold].
If this kills, gain {Energy} energy. Otherwise, lose {HpLoss} HP.
Combined level {UnionLevel} (+1 damage every 2).
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {Wounds} [gold]Scars[/gold]. Each play adds 1 Scar to this card this combat.
Combined level {UnionLevel} (+1 damage every 2).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_ENSOULED_BLADES.des:
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
[gold]Command[/gold] {Commands} times ({IaiDamage} damage each with Iai).
Then apply {Wounds} [gold]Scars[/gold] to the target.
Combined level {UnionLevel} (+1 Scar every 3).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_YOKAI_SLAYERS.title: Yokai Slayers
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_YOKAI_SLAYERS.descr:
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
[gold]Onimaru[/gold] strikes {Strikes} times as [gold]Taima[/gold], whatever its current kind.
Reduce one of your debuffs by 1.
(The strikes follow [gold]Onimaru[/gold]'s level.)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_SIDHE_LIGHT.title: Light of the Síde
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_SIDHE_LIGHT.descrip:
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
[gold]Draw-cut[/gold]: Consume all [gold]Light[/gold]. This card's damage ignores [gold]Block[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage + {PerLight} per Light.
Combined level {UnionLevel} (+1 damage every 2; damage per Light follows Solais' level).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_RELIQUARY_LIGHT.des:
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]. Gain {SolaisLightPower} [gold]Light[/gold].
Until your next turn, enemy attacks deal {Reduce} less per hit ([gold]Durandal[/gold]'s level).
Combined level {UnionLevel} (+1 Block every 2).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_TWO_FORGES.title: Two Forges
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_HIDDEN_BLADES.title: Hidden Blades
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_HIDDEN_BLADES.descr:
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Each time this is retained over a turn, +{RetainBonus} Block this combat.
Triggers [gold]Pair[/gold], and the next Ganjiang & Moye card triggers [gold]Pair[/gold] too.
Combined level {UnionLevel} (+1 Block every 2).
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNION_WILDFIRE_BLADE.desc:
[purple]Union[/purple] {SwordA} + {SwordB}
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] every Status and Curse in your hand.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Hits} times (1 + cards exhausted).
Combined level {UnionLevel} (+1 damage every 2).
